description: This file defines the NotLikeOperator class, a filter operator used in JSON API filters within the SuiteCRM project, specifically for string filtering with the 'NOT LIKE' SQL operator.

classes.name: NotLikeOperator
classes.description: A filter operator class implementing the 'NOT LIKE' SQL operator for string filtering in JSON API requests within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag used to identify this operator in JSON API filter expressions.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL string representation of this operator, which is 'NOT LIKE'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and defers additional validation to the parent method.
